Class ExactInterceptorBindingQualifier<T>

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.inject.qualifiers.FilteringQualifier<T>
io.micronaut.aop.ExactInterceptorBindingQualifier<T>
Type Parameters:
T - The bean type
All Implemented Interfaces:
Qualifier<T>
public final class ExactInterceptorBindingQualifier<T> extends FilteringQualifier<T>
Qualifies beans by their interceptor bindings the way the interceptor registry selects the interceptors of an interception point, for beans of any type.

A candidate qualifies when it declares at least one interceptor binding of the given kind and every one of them applies at the interception point, which may bind more:

  • a binding which does not bind members applies wherever the point has its binding annotation;
  • a binding with InterceptorBinding.bindMembers() applies when one of the occurrences of the binding annotation on the candidate is the same annotation as one at the point, compared with AnnotationValue.matches(AnnotationValue);
  • a binding which also sets InterceptorBinding.matchAllOccurrences() requires every occurrence on the candidate to be the same annotation as one at the point, with the occurrences declared on a method replacing those of its class.

Members marked NonBinding take no part. An occurrence built at runtime does not list them, and the members the other side lists are left out of it as well.

A candidate which does not declare its bindings through InterceptorBinding can be given by the occurrences of its binding annotations, see matches(Collection).

The bean-candidate pre-filter Qualifiers.byInterceptorBinding(AnnotationMetadata) instead accepts a candidate any of whose bindings applies.

Since:
5.3.0

    • of

      public static <T> ExactInterceptorBindingQualifier<T> of(AnnotationMetadata interceptionPoint, InterceptorKind kind)
      Qualifies the beans bound to an interception point.

      The occurrences of a binding annotation declared on a method replace those of its class, as the bindings themselves do. A point bound to an interceptor type, through @Type on its binding annotation, also qualifies a bean of that type or of a subtype of it.

      Type Parameters:
      T - The bean type
      Parameters:
      interceptionPoint - The metadata of the interception point, such as an executable method
      kind - The kind of the bindings to compare
      Returns:
      The qualifier

    • ofOccurrences

      public static <T> ExactInterceptorBindingQualifier<T> ofOccurrences(Collection<? extends AnnotationValue<?>> occurrences, InterceptorKind kind)
      Qualifies the beans bound to an interception point given by the occurrences of its binding annotations, such as the annotations of a programmatic lookup.

      Each value is an occurrence of a binding annotation, repeatable annotations given one value per occurrence. The binding annotations an occurrence composes and retains, read through AnnotationValue.getStereotypes(), are bindings of the point as well, as they are for a point read from metadata. A value built without the defaults of its annotation takes those of the occurrence it is compared with, so it may leave a defaulted member out.

      Type Parameters:
      T - The bean type
      Parameters:
      occurrences - The occurrences of the binding annotations of the point
      kind - The kind of the bindings to compare
      Returns:
      The qualifier

    • matches

      public boolean matches(Collection<? extends AnnotationValue<?>> candidateOccurrences)
      Whether a candidate given by the occurrences of its binding annotations is bound to the interception point, for a candidate which does not declare its bindings through InterceptorBinding, such as an interceptor class of another programming model which records its binding annotations itself.

      The occurrences are grouped by annotation, and each group is compared as a binding with InterceptorBinding.bindMembers() and InterceptorBinding.matchAllOccurrences(): the point must have the binding annotation, and every occurrence of the group must be the same annotation as one at the point, which may declare more. A binding the point has without binding members applies by name. Each value is an occurrence of a binding annotation, repeatable annotations given one value per occurrence, and the binding annotations an occurrence retains are bindings of the candidate as well.

      Parameters:
      candidateOccurrences - The occurrences of the binding annotations of the candidate
      Returns:
      Whether the candidate has at least one occurrence and every one of them applies at the point
